segments.name: Molecular diagnostics
segments.description: Provides prenatal and oncology molecular diagnostic testing services to patients, primarily in the United States, using its proprietary single-molecule next-generation sequencing platform.
segments.evidence: As such, the Company has determined that it is managed as one operating segment and one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Patients, the company's primary customers, pay for prenatal and oncology testing services performed on its proprietary molecular diagnostic technology platform.
revenueModel.evidence: Segment revenues are derived from prenatal and oncology testing services delivered to patients, the Company's primary customers; both the prenatal and oncology testing products utilize the Company's proprietary molecular diagnostic technology platform.
